name: Documentrio — AI Documentary Generator
description: Subscription SaaS that turns a prompt into a narrated documentary: GPT-4 writes the script, Eleven Labs voices it, the video is rendered and stored on S3, and a credit-based plan system meters usage through Stripe.

details.description: Built during the BuildSpace cohort and shipped as a working product. A creator picks a topic or a prompt preset, Documentrio scripts it, narrates it, assembles the video, and files it in the creator's collection. Plans are credit based, so every render is metered and billed through Stripe.
points: Creator Dashboard: Prompt input with ready-made presets, a My Collection gallery of finished renders, and an account page with monthly credit consumption charts.
Generation Pipeline: Multi-step orchestration where GPT-4 drafts the narrative, Eleven Labs produces the voiceover, and asynchronous Python workers assemble and render the video.
Media Storage: Finished videos, audio, and thumbnails stored on AWS S3 and served from the collection page.
Credits & Billing: Tiered subscription plans with a feature comparison table, Stripe checkout and webhooks, and per-render credit deduction with usage history.
Marketing Site: Landing page and an About section explaining the script, voiceover, and text-to-video tools, built on the same Next.js app.

name: App Ranker — AI Product Intelligence
description: AI-powered product discovery and semantic ranking platform that automatically ingests Product Hunt software launches, extracts feature vectors via GPT-4o-mini, and surfaces high-intent software matches.

details.description: App Ranker automates software market intelligence by aggregating newly launched products from Product Hunt, enriching data using OpenAI models, and computing semantic similarity vectors for intelligent ranking.
points: Automated Data Scraping: Continuous scraping pipeline aggregating newly launched tech products from Product Hunt.
LLM Feature Extraction: Utilized GPT-4o-mini to parse unstructured descriptions into structured feature matrices and target demographics.
Semantic Search: Vector embedding search allowing users to discover software using natural language queries.
Scalable SaaS: Built with Next.js, FastAPI, and Dockerized deployment with automated task scheduling.

details.description: Engineered and maintained CarFig from initial architectural design through deployment. Led development across consumer marketplace, administrative management portal, RESTful APIs, and cross-platform mobile apps.
points: End-to-End Ownership: Designed and delivered consumer portal, dealer management dashboard, and REST API backend.
Cross-Platform Mobile: Shipped iOS and Android mobile apps using React Native with native device feature integrations.
DevOps & VPS CI/CD: Automated deployment workflows using GitHub Actions on self-hosted VPS environments with Cloudflare edge caching.

name: ALS – Agent Listing Service
description: Full-scale real estate platform hosting 500,000+ verified agent profiles, featuring property listings, automated Crib Flyer generation, lead management, and real-time chat.

details.description: ALS is a comprehensive real estate network connecting over half a million agents across North America. Led both front-end and back-end development to deliver responsive, secure, and real-time experiences.
points: Massive Directory: Scaled platform to house 500,000+ verified agent profiles with sub-second search and location filtering.
Marketing Automation: Built dynamic Crib Flyer generator that renders branded property PDF and web flyers on the fly.
Real-Time Messaging: Integrated WebSocket communication for instant agent-client messaging, contract sharing, and lead notifications.
Granular Admin Control: Built multi-tier administrative panels for profile claiming, verification, and payment plan subscriptions.

name: Brothers Mart — B2B Packaging E-Commerce & Admin CMS

details.description: Engineered the complete Brothers Mart platform: a customer storefront, a REST API, and an admin panel the client's team uses daily to run the catalog and fulfil orders. The business sells packaging in bulk to restaurants, so the catalog is organised by restaurant type as well as by product category and brand.
points: Storefront: Hero and promotional packaging showcase, shop by category and by restaurant type, discount deals grid, best sellers, a brands directory with search, and a catalog page with multi-faceted filters.
Product & Cart: Single-item pages with specifications and bundle offers, a cart with VAT calculation and an automatic shipping cost calculator, and a customer account area with order history.
Payments: Redsys Virtual POS integration with 3D Secure card processing and Bizum instant payments.
Logistics: MRW shipping integrated over their SOAP API for rates, label generation, and dispatch tracking, with invoices and labels rendered to PDF via Puppeteer.

Admin CMS: Multi-step product builder with variant settings, display products manager for homepage promotion cards, banner configuration with localisation, general settings and company policies forms, and a fulfilment dashboard for processing orders.
Analytics & Ops: Store performance metrics, recent orders summary, Cloudinary image pipeline, rate limiting and JWT auth on the API, and transactional email via Nodemailer.
Bilingual: Spanish and English across the storefront with next-intl, and localised banner content managed from the CMS.

name: Noor Boutique — E-Commerce & Custom SDK

points: Custom Payment Gateway SDK: Reverse-engineered and converted the Plutu PHP payment API into a reusable JavaScript/TypeScript SDK.
Real-Time Delivery Coordination: Integrated Socket.IO for live driver status updates and real-time customer push notifications.
State Management: Leveraged Redux for deterministic cart states, multi-currency pricing, and responsive order tracking.

points: Full Retail POS: Multiple payment types, barcode scanning, thermal receipt printing, and split-tender billing.

Live Scout Chat: WebSocket-powered messaging allowing verified recruiters to initiate direct conversations with prospects.

details.description: Developed an on-demand food delivery platform pairing customer mobile ordering with live logistics dispatch and store inventory synchronization.
points: Live Driver Routing: Real-time driver dispatch and order tracking using Google Maps API.
Inventory Synchronization: Automated stock deduction and low-inventory alerts across grocery SKUs.

Visual Reporting: Weekly and monthly inventory turnover analytics and automated restock suggestions.

CRM Automation: GraphQL and REST integration syncing new leads directly into Monday.com boards.

name: Ascent Immigration — UK Visa Consultancy Website
description: WordPress site for a UK immigration consultancy with visa and service post types, a personal and corporate visa navigator, detailed visa pages with a table-of-contents widget, service packages, testimonials, FAQ, blog, and a contact form with WhatsApp chat.

details.description: Built the Ascent Immigration site on WordPress so the firm could publish and maintain dozens of visa and service pages themselves. Visas and services are separate post types with their own templates, grouped under personal and corporate immigration, and every page ends in a consultation call to action.
points: Visa & Service Post Types: Structured content for 80+ visa categories and four service packages, each with a consistent template and category taxonomy.
Visa Navigator: Personal and corporate tabs on the home page listing family, ancestry, skilled worker, visitor, and other routes with eligibility summaries.
Long-Form Pages: Visa requirement pages with a sticky table-of-contents widget so applicants can jump between eligibility, documents, fees, and processing times.
Conversion Path: Four-step guidance workflow, service package grid, client testimonials, FAQ accordion, and a WhatsApp chat widget alongside the contact form.

details.description: Developed an engaging real estate platform with interactive search and property valuation tools, backed by a custom PHP/MySQL content management system.
points: Interactive Tools: Integrated financial mortgage calculators and interactive map-based property locators.
Figma to Code: Flawlessly translated high-fidelity Figma designs into responsive, cross-browser web pages.
Admin Portal: Full CRUD management interface for agents to upload listings, update pricing, and manage buyer inquiries.

name: ThunderJaw — Restaurant POS, Online Ordering & Delivery Suite
description: End-to-end restaurant platform: an offline-first Electron POS with kitchen display and thermal printer routing, a Next.js ordering storefront with delivery-zone validation, Expo customer and driver apps, an admin panel, and a VPS server that keeps every order in sync.

details.description: ThunderJaw started as a desktop POS for a busy restaurant and grew into a full operations suite built and maintained by one engineer. The POS runs entirely offline on the venue's workstations, the storefront takes web orders, drivers get their own app, and a central server reconciles everything so a customer can watch their order move from the kitchen to their door.
points: Offline-First POS: Electron app with a local database and IPC bridge keeps cashiers taking orders through internet outages. Changes queue locally and flush to the server every 15 seconds with automatic retry.

Order Lifecycle & Sync: Web orders land on the server as web-pending, the POS polls every 10 seconds, acknowledges them, and every status change (sent to kitchen, ready, out for delivery, delivered) syncs back so the customer's tracking page updates live.
Kitchen Display System: Dedicated kitchen screen receives tickets the moment a cashier sends them, marks items ready, and hands delivery orders to dispatch.

Thermal Printer Routing: Products map to specific ESC/POS printers (kitchen, bar, grill), receipts handle split and partial payments, and web tickets print with a W- prefix so staff can tell channels apart.
Order Types: Dine-in, pickup, and delivery at the counter, web delivery and pickup from the storefront, and platform order types reserved for Glovo and Uber Eats integration.
Online Storefront: Next.js customer site with menu browsing, checkout, delivery address validation against polygon delivery zones on Google Maps, and an account page with active and past orders.
Mobile & Driver Apps: Expo React Native apps for customers and for drivers, with GPS location, push notifications, map-based dispatch, and background location tasks for live delivery tracking.
Admin Panel: Next.js back office for menu, categories, variants, printer assignments, and content, with image compression and a rich-text editor.
Back Office in the POS: Menu management with drag-and-drop ordering, configurations, staff and delivery person accounts, reports with charts, and Excel export.
Bilingual: Spanish and English across the POS, storefront, and apps through i18next and shared locale files.
Deployment: Single installable desktop binary for the venue, VPS-hosted Express and PostgreSQL server with JWT auth, and Knex migrations on both sides to keep schemas in step.

details.description: Engineered and shipped native mobile apps for the CarFig automotive marketplace, taking complete ownership of mobile development from UI implementation to App Store/Play Store deployments.
points: Native Device Integration: High-resolution camera capture with native compression for fast vehicle listing uploads.
Push Notifications: Background alerts for price drops, new matching listings, and direct buyer inquiries.
Cross-Platform Release: Handled independent mobile lifecycles across iOS and Android ecosystems.

points: Token Onboarding: Secure invitation links with Pending and Onboarded status tracking replace manual contract distribution.
Contract Workflows: Custom contract text, document upload, acceptance tracking, and downloadable signed copies.

White-Labelling: Per-business display name and logo so each firm presents its own brand to preparers.

points: Project Tracking: Timelines, task assignment, and progress monitoring across teams.
HR Module: Employee records, leave, and attendance tied to the same user directory as projects.
Reporting: Automated weekly reports and dashboards for leadership visibility.
Access Control: Role-based permissions separating staff, managers, and administrators.

details.description: Built the user-facing app, admin panel, and API for Cybenty. The platform pairs training content with practical tools so learners can check their own exposure while they study.
points: Gamified Learning: Interactive assessments and courses with progress tracking and scoring.
Leak Detection: Instant lookup of whether an email address appears in known data breaches.
Secure Sharing: Password-protected secrets that expire automatically after a set time or view count.

Admin Dashboard: Content management, learner tracking, and organisation-level training oversight.

points: Tutor Marketplace: Filtering by subject, price, and native language with Stripe checkout for bookings.
Student Analytics: Real-time GPA, attendance, and performance charts on each profile.
Scheduling: Calendar invites, reminders by email and SMS, and live session notifications over Socket.IO.
Course Catalog: Dedicated landing pages for technical deep-dives such as Advanced JavaScript and React.

points: Multi-Model Orchestration: Text and image generation routed to the best model per task under one interface.
Editable Canvases: Rich-text and image editing with export to PDF.

High-Interaction UI: Streaming responses, skeleton states, and keyboard-driven workflows for fast iteration.

Retention Touches: Recently viewed products strip, trust badges for shipping, returns, and support, and a search drawer with trending terms.

points: Shopping Flow: Store discovery, shop by category and brand, product details with variants, saved items, cart, and checkout.
Orders & Account: Order details and history, account and settings screens, and a help and support desk inside the app.

Native Touches: Expo Router navigation with bottom tabs, haptics, localisation, and PDF invoice sharing through the device share sheet.

description: Next.js ordering site for a kebab restaurant in Rivas, Madrid: menu with dish customisation and ingredient exclusions, set-menu configurator, delivery or pickup checkout with address lookup, live order tracker, Google reviews feed, account with order history, and a support messaging portal.

details.description: The customer-facing web channel of the ThunderJaw restaurant suite, built for Ali Doner Kebab. Orders placed here land on the restaurant's POS within seconds, print in the kitchen, and the customer can watch the status change on their screen without refreshing.
points: Menu & Customisation: Full menu grid by category, dish pages with ingredient exclusions and extras, and a set-menu configurator for combos such as the lahmacun menu with drink selection.
Checkout: Delivery or pickup selection, delivery address validation against the restaurant's polygon delivery zones on Google Maps, and an order confirmation screen with the delivery estimate.

Account & Support: Email verification, password reset, order history with reorder, and a support portal with a messaging thread to the restaurant.

points: Ordering Flow: Menu, item detail with allergen information and customisation, favourites, cart, and checkout with delivery or pickup selection.
